name: Pylint

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  pylint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: pip

      - name: Install lint dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pylint
          pip install -e "./src/trading_crab_lib[dev,plotting]"
          pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Analyse source code with pylint
        run: |
          pylint src/trading_crab src/trading_crab_lib
